message: Your attempt to sound clever with the "revisionist history" label is laughable - it's you who's cherry-picking history to fit your narrative. The Second Amendment is complex, but let's be real, it's not just about hunting. It's about the collective understanding of the right to self-defense at the time it was written. And by the way, who are you to dictate what constitutes "controlling our private lives" - you're the one pushing for more government control, not me. At least I'm not advocating for the disarmament of law-abiding citizens so that only the government can decide who's "safe" or not.

runs.justification: Persona 2 uses sarcasm ('Your attempt to sound clever... is laughable') and caricature ('cherry-picking history to fit your narrative') to mock Persona 1's argument, rather than engaging with it directly.
